title: Attribute native indexed context reads on the world map
changes: Add an opt-in test observer that attributes generated API reads of the indexed-graphics context owner on the retained ordinary world-map route.
validation: Wine ax_5va8t passes the 41-frame E170 raw/managed pair with equal full state, clock, video, OAM, dispatch and five nonempty audio streams. All four traced context-3 requests and four typed bytes are direct generated API calls, with no raw or unclassified context reads and all 132 backing source bytes altered.
Windows GNU build 8n1s8g8b passed; inputs were protected, Wine drained and successful scratch was removed.
limitations: The wrapper identifies direct generated API calls, not exact guest load PCs. Other contexts, callers, the full reader ABI, native Windows, Linux and USA remain open.
